disposition_reason: Retail survey of 244 samples of nine edible mushroom species from 10 cities in Shaanxi, China, analysed for lead, cadmium, arsenic, mercury and chromium by ICP-MS; species means are in Table 3 and pooled ranges in Table 4.

study.design: Cross-sectional retail survey, simple random sampling
study.market: Supermarkets, farmers' markets and small traders in 10 cities of Shaanxi Province, China
study.method: Microwave HNO3/H2O2 digestion, ICP-MS (iCAP Qc), GB 5009.268-2016
study.qa: Certified reference materials and parallel samples stated; spike recoveries Pb 93.5-100.0%, Cd 94.2-98.6%, Cr 97.0-101.4%, As 90.1-99.5%, Hg 90.0-99.5% (Table 2)

unresolved: Text says 2 samples exceeded the lead limit and 12 exceeded the arsenic limit, while Table 4 prints 4/244 and 20/244.
Table 4 dispersion values may be standard errors rather than SDs.
Wild versus cultivated status of species (e.g. morel) is not stated.
Pollution indices and THQ (Tables 5-6) are derived values, not concentrations.
